[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Desk Walk: Walk around your office every hour for 5-10 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Chair Squats: Stand up and sit down in your chair without using your hands for 3 sets of 10-15 reps.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Leg Raises: Lift one leg off the floor for 3 sets of 10-15 reps on each leg.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Arm Circles: Hold arms straight out to the sides and make small circles for 3 sets of 30-60 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Desk Tap: Stand up and tap your feet on the floor in front of your desk for 3 sets of 30-60 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include:
